Job Description

About us: &#xA;&#xA; Foodsmart is the leading telenutrition and foodcare solution, backed by a robust network of Registered Dietitians. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver long-term health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide our 2.2 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. &#xA;&#xA; Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG&rsquo;s Rise Fund to help expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases. &#xA;&#xA; Our core values: &#xA;&#xA; 👥 Customer First — You start with the member and work backwards. &#xA;&#xA; 🚀 Make It Happen — You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. &#xA;&#xA; 🤝 One Team — You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. &#xA;&#xA; About the role: &#xA;&#xA; Foodsmart&rsquo;s Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) team builds the telenutrition and foodcare platform used by members, providers, and partners. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow an engineering organization of approximately 16 engineers, setting technical direction and management practices that keep the team shipping reliable, high-quality software. You&rsquo;ll partner closely with product and design to translate roadmap priorities into well-architected systems, champion the adoption of AI throughout our engineering practices, and raise the bar on our full-stack web platform. &#xA;&#xA; You will &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; Lead AI-native development: Bring strong, hands-on AI experience to guide teams building AI-native software products architected around AI from the ground up spanning agentic workflows, LLM-powered services, and AI-assisted engineering practices, not just AI-adjacent features. &#xA; Own four AI pods end to end: Directly manage four AI-focused pods, each accountable for delivering specific features and outcomes. You own execution, delivery, quality, and velocity across all four. &#xA; Manage cross-pod dependencies and risk: Identify where pods&rsquo; roadmaps intersect, sequence work to avoid bottlenecks, and proactively surface and mitigate risks before they threaten delivery. &#xA; Shape architecture: Participate in and help drive architecture reviews across our React.js/TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, PostgreSQL, and Redshift stack, ensuring decisions hold up for scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability, including in a HIPAA/SOC 2-aware environment. &#xA; Stay outcome-focused: Keep teams anchored to member and business impact rather than pure output, helping them prioritize the work that moves the needle. &#xA; Champion AI adoption: Drive the practical use of AI across engineering from AI-assisted development tooling to AI-powered product features, keeping the org current with emerging tools and practices. &#xA; Drive engineering excellence: Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, incident response, and CI/CD practices across the pods. &#xA; Mentor and develop talent: Coach engineers and tech leads at all levels, building the next generation of technical leadership inside the org. &#xA; Communicate and collaborate: Act as a clear, consistent communicator and trusted partner across engineering, product, design, and leadership, translating technical realities for non-technical stakeholders and vice versa. &#xA; &#xA;&#xA; You are &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; A people-first, hands-on leader who invests in coaching engineers at every level and has led organizations of a similar size (10+ engineers). &#xA; A systems thinker who brings clarity to ambiguity, balances speed against risk, and earns trust across both technical and non-technical stakeholders. &#xA; Calm under pressure, with crisp written, verbal, and executive communication, and comfortable making and documenting decisions. &#xA; Genuinely curious about AI, with real interest in its application to both engineering workflows and product development , not just familiarity with the term. &#xA; Highly adaptable, quick to pivot as priorities shift, consistently responsive, and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture. &#xA; An outcome-driven operator who ties engineering decisions back to measurable business and member impact. &#xA; &#xA;&#xA; You have &#xA;&#xA; &#xA; 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams, with a track record leading 10+ engineers (startup or high-growth environment preferred). &#xA; Strong, hands-on AI-native development experience building products with agentic systems, LLM integrations, or AI-first architectures and a track record applying AI to both engineering workflows and product features. &#xA; A proven track record managing multiple engineering teams simultaneously, with clear accountability for delivery, quality, and velocity. &#xA; Experience managing cross-team dependencies and risk in a fast-moving, multi-pod environment. &#xA; Experience running engineering delivery with Agile/Lean practices (Scrum/Kanban) using tools like Jira and Confluence. &#xA; A track record of setting technical direction and making sound architecture decisions for scalable, full-stack web applications. &#xA; Deep working knowledge of our core stack: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, SQS, &#xA; DynamoDB), PostgreSQL, and Redshift, along with Docker/Kubernetes for containerized, orchestrated deployments, and familiarity with GraphQL and RESTful API design. &#xA; A strong outcome/value-oriented mindset, with a track record of tying engineering work to business impact. &#xA; Excellent mentorship and coaching skills, with genuine investment in developing people. &#xA; Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. &#xA; Experience in regulated environments (healthcare/digital health preferred), with HIPAA/SOC 2 awareness and audit-friendly change management, is a plus. &#xA;
